bullets.text: Ten people were killed in a Russian attack on a drone exhibition near Kyiv, with ballistic missiles hitting the event attended by prominent members of the Ukrainian defence industry.
The US and Iran traded more strikes in the Gulf, increasing fears of escalation as Iran condemned the US plan to use frozen Iranian assets for war damages.
A health worker is being monitored in a London hospital for Ebola after being evacuated from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where an outbreak of the disease is occurring.
Plans for worker accommodation for a $1.5 billion Queensland wind farm are facing opposition from Kingaroy residents, despite the proposed $68 million investment.
Four regional RSL sub-branches in Sunraysia, Victoria, are merging to sustain veterans' services amid declining numbers and increased administrative burdens faced by RSLs across the state.

Australian households may face an interest rate hike and petrol prices exceeding $2 per litre, according to economists, as the escalating Middle East crisis drives global crude oil prices above $US100 a barrel.
Commodity trading giant Vitol Group distributed $5.9 billion to its executives and senior staff last year through share buybacks, despite its profits halving to $4.2 billion.
US tech groups have eliminated 140,000 jobs amidst an AI spending boom, indicating a significant reshaping of Silicon Valley while the broader US jobs market remains stable.
The dollar concluded its strongest week in a month as investors sought a traditional safe haven due to escalating geopolitical tensions.
